priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:2 still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the PR-changed disposer at line 3 remains `return () => {};`. The full diff confirms this replaced the base's `socket.off("message", handler)`, so cleanup still neither detaches nor releases the handler.
